scope: Short editorial evaluation only; not full media generation, blind testing or learner acceptance.

evals.name: anc-opening
evals.prompt: 为普通读者写一段解释页的首屏文案，回答：为什么降噪耳机减弱了飞机轰鸣，却仍可能听见人声？输出中文和英文各一个标题及两段短正文，不写 HTML、不联网。已有调研支持：在耳边同一点、同一时刻，两路声压相加；大小接近、起伏相反时叠加后的起伏减小。低频变化较慢，同样残余时间误差占一个周期的比例较小，这是通常更有利于主动降噪的原因之一。人声含多种频率及随时间变化的成分，部分减弱不等于所有语音线索消失。耳垫或耳塞贴合影响被动隔音，也影响主动控制的声学条件。不能推出所有人声都不能被降低、固定高低频分界或实测降噪量。作者草记：难点是正确时刻产生恰当声压并在耳边匹配。低频是有利情况。人声是组合。密封仍重要。请把这些材料写成面向读者的解释，不输出过程说明。
evals.expected_output: Natural independently readable Chinese and English copy connecting the local cancellation mechanism to the rumble/speech contrast without measurement claims.
assertions: Both languages identify the two pressure contributions, their common ear location and opposing changes; matching is not left unspecified.
Both languages connect low frequency with slower change or a smaller relative timing error rather than merely calling it favorable.
Both languages connect remaining speech components or cues to possible audibility without categorically excluding speech from ANC.
The copy explains a role of fit without an equal split or universal frequency boundary.
Titles and body preserve qualifications and introduce no measured attenuation or product-performance guarantee.
Each title alone identifies noise-cancelling headphones and the rumble/speech question, without requiring the prompt or a subtitle.

evals.name: git-net-change
evals.prompt: 为刚开始协作开发的读者写一段 Git merge 解释页文案，中文和英文各一个标题及两段短正文，不写 HTML、不运行代码。问题：我方提交多，还把 timeout 改了又还原，为什么合并时却保留了对方的修改？本题已经验证的普通文本合并输入：共同基准 timeout=30；我方经历 30→60→30，当前内容为30；对方从30改成60；没有其他相关变化，合并结果为60。Git 比较双方最终快照相对于共同基准的变化，而不是按提交数投票或逐个重放提交。还原不构成对其他分支修改的永久否决。该案例是普通分叉合并，不推广到所有驱动和历史；文本合并成功不证明程序行为正确。作者草记：Three snapshots. Not a replay. 我方尖端等于基准，对方有净变化。请组织成自然解释，保留必要范围但不要用审计说明淹没主线。
evals.expected_output: Concrete three-way reasoning anchored to 30/60 values, natural novice terminology and preserved scope in both languages.
assertions: Both languages name or explain the common baseline and both current branch versions using the supplied values.
Both languages explain why ours contributes no net change and why the result is 60 rather than just announcing the result.
Neither language treats commit count, replay or revert as a vote overriding the other branch.
Novice-facing terminology is introduced intelligibly instead of leaving branch tip or 尖端 unexplained.
The copy scopes the text-merge example and does not equate a clean merge with correct program behavior.

Each title alone identifies Git merge and reverted changes rather than using unexplained 30/60 values; the lead names timeout before introducing its values and treats the change, not the number, as reverted.

evals.name: cold-glass-transfer
evals.prompt: 为普通读者写一段生活科普页文案，中文和英文各一个标题及两段短正文，不写 HTML、不联网。问题：冷饮杯外的水珠是从杯子里漏出来的吗？请只依据给定材料写作：这里讨论完整、不漏水的杯子；空气含水蒸气，杯中冷饮使杯壁温度降低；当杯壁低于周围空气的露点时，空气中的水蒸气可在外壁凝结成液滴。水珠主要来自周围空气，不是透过杯壁的饮料。露点是给定空气开始凝结所对应的温度；湿度条件不同，是否凝结也会不同。不能据此断言每个冷杯都会有水珠，不能用本例排除真实破损杯子的漏水。作者草记：关键是温差。水是空气里的。湿度仍然重要。请写得有吸引力而且读得懂，不添加具体温度或未经给定材料支持的机制。
evals.expected_output: A held-out topic testing whether the guidance supplies the cold surface/condensation bridge and defines the relevant condition without relying on the ANC/Git examples.
assertions: Both languages trace the droplets to air water vapor on the outside rather than drink passing through the wall.
Both languages connect the cold drink, cooler wall and condensation rather than leaving temperature difference unspecified.
The dew-point condition is explained in approachable terms in both languages, not merely named.
Both languages preserve conditional condensation and the intact-cup scope without excluding actual leaks in damaged cups.
No unsupported numerical threshold or unrelated physical mechanism is added; the two versions preserve the same conditions.
Each title alone identifies droplets on a cold cup and their origin question, without relying on an unexplained pronoun or a later definition.
